name: oblique-below
airframe: Fighter1, Multirole1, SmallFighter1, trainer, VTOLTrainer1, EW1, FastBomber1, Darkreach
note: The same 6 deg oblique diamond as oblique-6, but centred 20 deg BELOW the horizon - the v0.85 elDn regime, entered at small step sizes. elDn is the one segment in the whole corpus where roll and yaw genuinely fight (42.0% of samples commanding opposite signs, against 0-12% everywhere else), and it is also the only one flown deep below the nose. This card separates those two facts: if the cross-fighting follows the BELOWNESS it will show up here at 6 deg steps; if it followed the 20 deg step size it will not. Entry is 6000 m, not 4000: 38 s nose-down at 250 m/s spends ~3.3 km. Its control is its OWN mirror pairs, not oblique-6 (different altitude, and speed builds throughout). AIRFRAME: any jet at the fixedwing-v2 entry condition. ROSTER TRIMMED 2026-08-02 (task #82): CAS1 (0.95*Vmax = 195.3) and COIN (134.6) cannot reach this card's absolute 250 m/s, so TestDrone.EntrySpeedFlyable REFUSED those two lanes pre-spawn on every run ever flown from it - the card declared 10 lanes and flew 8, silently. They are removed rather than left as guaranteed refusals; the ten-key comparison lives in the -c twin, which enters at 0.95x each lane's own FBW corner and which all ten keys clear. CARD-OWNED VALUES (v1.0.3): Drone/DroneAltDeckM = 0 - corpus: this card last flew in R28 (v0.92.1), before Drone/DroneAltDeckM existed (v0.99), so every lane flew one deck.
